culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At the morning alms round (Sai Bat or Tak Bat), watch quietly from at least 5 metres, do not block or touch the monks, use no flash, and dress with shoulders, chest and legs covered. Only give if you mean to, with food bought beforehand; do not follow the procession by bus or stand above the monks.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: The alms round is a daily religious ritual, around 5.30 to 6.30 am March to October and 6 to 7 am November to February.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Luang Prabang's monastic community; Tourism Luang Prabang
